app.name: Lahijan
app.description: Lahijan is an open-source cloud platform for compute, DNS, and object storage. Self-host with one docker compose command.

hero.title: Your cloud, your rules.
hero.subtitle: Compute, DNS, and object storage behind one clean self-service portal. Deploy in minutes with a single command.

features.sectionTitle: Everything you need to run a cloud
features.sectionSubtitle: Three best-of-breed backends, one unified control plane, zero vendor lock-in.

compute.title: Compute
compute.body: Provision system containers and virtual machines on demand. Full instance lifecycle, profiles, devices, and networks.

dns.title: DNS
dns.body: Authoritative DNS for your zones, with a records editor that gets out of your way.

storage.title: Object storage
storage.body: S3-compatible buckets with per-user credentials. Your apps hit the data plane directly; Lahijan manages policies.

plugins.title: WASM plugins
plugins.body: Extend the platform with sandboxed WebAssembly modules. Android-style permissions keep you in control.

rbac.title: RBAC + audit
rbac.body: Role-based access control with an append-only audit trail. Every privileged action is recorded.

billing.title: PAYG billing
billing.body: Top up user balances and meter usage per minute. A ledger you can reconcile, not a black box.

howItWorks.sectionSubtitle: One platform, three concerns, a single deploy.

step1.title: Deploy
step1.body: Run docker compose up. Lahijan brings up its database and the three backends it wraps.

step2.title: Onboard
step2.body: Invite users, set their quotas, and top up their balance. They get a self-service portal for compute, DNS, and S3.

step3.title: Scale
step3.body: Every resource meters per minute. The ledger records every credit and debit; receipts are a query away.

codeSnippet.label: Get started in one command
codeSnippet.comment: # clone, configure, bring the stack up

architecture.sectionSubtitle: A monolithic control plane over three focused backends.
architecture.browserBody: REST/JSON for control; S3 direct for data.
architecture.backendBody: One GoFiber monolith. REST API, services, repository layer, job queue, WASM runtime.
architecture.databaseBody: Shared by Lahijan and the backends. Row-level tenant isolation.
architecture.backendsBody: Three best-of-breed backends, abstracted behind the Lahijan API.

faq.sectionSubtitle: Short answers to the questions operators ask first.

selfhost.a: Yes. The whole stack — Lahijan, its database, and the three backends — runs from one docker compose file.

backends.a: Lahijan wraps three mature open-source projects for compute, DNS, and object storage. They are abstracted behind the Lahijan API; end users never see their names.

multiTenant.a: Yes. Every row in the database carries a tenant id, enforced at the repository layer. Tenants cannot see each other's data.

pricing.a: Each operator sets their own unit prices. Users prepay into a balance; usage is metered per minute and debited from the ledger.

plugins.a: WebAssembly modules that extend Lahijan with new automation. Each plugin declares a permission manifest; admins approve each permission at install time.

sdk.a: Yes. Every action you can do in the UI you can do over a versioned REST API with generated client libraries.

about.title: About Lahijan
about.subtitle: Why we're building it.
about.lead: Lahijan is an open-source project building the self-service cloud platform we wished existed: opinionated, multi-tenant, and free to run.

mission.title: Mission
mission.body: Give every operator the same tools the big clouds have, without the lock-in or the price tag.

transparent.title: Transparent infrastructure
transparent.body: Three focused backends, abstracted behind one API. Operators see everything; users see a clean portal.

tenantIsolation.title: Tenant isolation by construction
tenantIsolation.body: Row-level isolation enforced in the repository layer, not bolted on after.

open.title: Open source, open process
open.body: Every decision is recorded. Every line is on a public repo.

nameOrigin.title: Why Lahijan?
nameOrigin.body: Lahijan is named after the city of Lahijan in northern Iran. The project's voice is bilingual from day one: English and Persian.

privacy.lead: This is a boilerplate privacy policy. Each Lahijan deployment is operated independently; the operator of your deployment is responsible for customizing this document.

scope.title: Scope
scope.body: This policy describes how the operator of your Lahijan deployment handles data. The Lahijan project itself does not collect any data from deployments.

data.title: Data we process
data.body: Account credentials, billing ledger entries, resource configuration, audit log entries, and usage telemetry required to operate the platform.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: Audit log entries are append-only and retained per the operator's policy. Other data is removed when the corresponding account or resource is deleted.
